newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea says unlikely boat landed infiltrators.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea says unlikely boat landed infiltrators.

text.p: A North Korean vessel found grounded off South Korea's east coast on Tuesday is thought to have drifted in during a storm and is unlikely to have landed any infiltrators, a South Korean Defence Ministry official said.
"We believe the boat drifted to the South. It doesn't look like an infiltration vessel," said the official, who declined to be named.
He said the steel-hulled boat may have been pushed South by heavy seas.
The official confirmed reports that a notebook had been found on board praising North Korean leader Kim Jong-il.
A joint military and police investigation team had been formed to look into the incident, he added.
